gen-gf-metamorphous-gf-preahvihear: Stately and a bit smoky, Metamorphous spaces its letters generously and lets its strokes swell and thin with a soft hand. Preahvihear, a sans with a lofty x-height, opens its letters wide.
gen-gf-metamorphous-gf-prompt: Metamorphous has curved strokes that lighten gently toward their ends, which gives the headline a carved, commanding look. And Prompt follows with oversized small letters and open apertures, easy to read in sans-serif form.
gen-gf-metamorphous-gf-questrial: Carved, commanding, a little theatrical: Metamorphous weighs its thick and thin strokes the way thread sits against yarn. Questrial runs flat and open, with no swelling at the curves.
gen-gf-metamorphous-gf-radio-canada-big: Commanding is how Metamorphous looks, with hairlines that are neither wispy nor heavy and generous space around each letter. Radio Canada Big keeps one stroke thickness throughout, so paragraphs move along smoothly.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-ubuntu-sans: Goldman's round forms bow open like parentheses, spaced wide with a lowercase that towers over its capitals. Ubuntu Sans draws tubular, constant-width strokes with big open eyes, so shrinking Goldman would crowd it while enlarging Ubuntu Sans would feel heavy.
gen-gf-metamorphous-gf-roboto: Metamorphous leads with a commanding, distinctive voice. Roboto, a sans-serif with generous mouths on its round letters, keeps a long passage moving smoothly because its capitals and lowercase sit at nearly the same height, with no jolts.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-sen: Funnel Display draws spaghetti-like strokes, all one width. Sen matches that steadiness with tall lowercase and curves that stop before turning inward, and the shared line weight is what makes the two feel like relatives.
gen-gf-offside-gf-aldrich: Offside stretches its letters wide, with curves that refuse to close and a quiet, level beat. And Aldrich is the one to resize, since its x-height nearly reaches the capitals, so a slightly smaller body setting still reads comfortably.
gen-gf-offside-gf-anek-devanagari: Anek Devanagari opens its letter mouths distinctly and lifts a tall middle zone, a modern sans without fuss. Anek Devanagari carries a long passage comfortably, while Offside's cut-ribbon strokes of constant width stay in the heading.
gen-gf-offside-gf-blinker: Offside's curves refuse to close, and its widely tracked letters keep a quiet, level beat. Blinker holds its line thickness steady with open apertures and lowercase filling most of the height, which is the pair's strongest quality.
